caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object resembling a small shrine or ornamental box, featuring architectural and sculptural details. The structure has a square base with a domed roof, colored in dark blue with white outlines and topped with a small sphere. The front side shows a recessed alcove with a single human figure dressed in a red and blue garment and holding what appears to be a rectangular object; the figure stands in front of a background with quatrefoil designs. The sides of the structure are decorated with intricate patterns, including geometric and circular motifs with a red, blue, and beige color scheme. The top edge around the structure is adorned with red floral or leaflike embellishments. The entire object is set against a plain, unadorned beige background, and the name "Grace Halpin" is written in small script in the lower right area of the sheet.
title: Penny Bank
